title: Registering a Community Garden Plot
key_sentences: The town of Elsby offers forty garden plots each season.
Applications open on the first of February and close when every plot is taken.
Plots are assigned in the order in which applications are received.
A waiting list is kept for the following season.

list_items.text: 1) Fill in the application form at the town hall.
2) Choose one of the three plot sizes:
3) Pay the seasonal fee at the cashier's desk.
4) Collect your key and a copy of the garden rules.

notes: Markers are typed in the text ('1)' ... '4)' and 'i.', 'ii.', 'iii.'), so list_items include them. The roman items are indented under item 2) and are level 1. The apostrophe in cashier's is ASCII U+0027. 'To register, follow these steps.' is body text introducing the list.
